description.value: Friendly Thai Restaurant is an authentic Thai eatery on Gibsons Way, Sunshine Coast, run by an executive chef with 30 years of experience who trained at the renowned Thai House restaurant in Vancouver. The menu spans over 40 dishes including Thai curries, noodles, stir-fries, and classic soups like Tom Yum and Tom Kah, with both dine-in and takeout available. Reviewers consistently praise it as a hidden gem with generous portions and genuinely flavourful cooking.

address.value: Unit 1A - 682 Gibsons Way, Gibsons, B.C. V0N 1V9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address, phone number, and operating status. Takeout is confirmed by a dedicated Take Out Menu section on the website. Vegetarian options are confirmed by menu items including Vegetable Spring Roll and Deep Fried Tofu. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website or OSM tags.
concerns: Website customer reviews reference a former 'King George location' in Surrey that closed; this does not affect the Gibsons listing but indicates the business previously had a second location. No impact on current listing status.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, confirmed address, and a full menu. Straightforward inclusion as a Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Vegetable Spring Roll and Deep Fried Tofu (served with peanut sauce) as distinct vegetarian appetizer options; no GF or vegan labelling confirmed
